data.title: Investigate slow-wave drive not muting audio

data.body: Findings: In master feedback, band drive is computed from the current value relative to threshold before dwell/quality gating, but band active and payload.inhibit_active are computed after _dwell_active. Audio mutes from payload.inhibit_active, not drive. The dwell history only updates when quality_score >= QUALITY_GATE and artifact_fraction < ARTIFACT_GATE. Synthetic reproduction: with good quality, sustained slow-wave PSD activates inhibit; with artifact_fraction=0.5, drive remains 1.0 while samples stop updating and active/inhibit drop false after the dwell window. This explains high slow-wave drive and bar/threshold plots alongside no activation line or mute. Likely fix: decouple inhibit dwell from the quality/artifact-gated calibration history, or make inhibit conditions use immediate_active/current drive for muting while keeping quality-gated history only for threshold calibration.
Review: Investigated backend runtime and frontend audio mapping. No code change. Cause and candidate fix recorded.
